local connections = {}
local function track(c) table.insert(connections, c) return c end

local function tween(obj, props, dur)
    Tween:Create(obj, TweenInfo.new(dur or 0.16, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), props):Play()
end

local function addHover(btn, base, hover)
    btn.MouseEnter:Connect(function() tween(btn, {BackgroundColor3 = hover}) end)
    btn.MouseLeave:Connect(function() tween(btn, {BackgroundColor3 = base}) end)
end

local statusToken = 0
local function setStatus(txt)
    statusToken += 1
    local my = statusToken
    statusLbl.Text = txt
    task.delay(3, function()
        if statusToken == my then statusLbl.Text = "Ready." end
    end)
end

local activeDrag = nil

track(UIS.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
    if not activeDrag then return end
    if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement
    or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
        activeDrag(input)
    end
end))

track(UIS.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
    if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
    or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
        activeDrag = nil
    end
end))

local function makeSlider(parent, labelText, min, max, default, callback)
    local row = makeCard(parent, 58)

    local lbl = Instance.new("TextLabel")
    lbl.Size = UDim2.new(1, -100, 0, 18)
    lbl.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(14, 7)
    lbl.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    lbl.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham
    lbl.TextSize = 12
    lbl.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
    lbl.TextColor3 = Theme.Text
    lbl.Text = labelText
    lbl.Parent = row

    local box = Instance.new("TextBox")
    box.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(78, 22)
    box.Position = UDim2.new(1, -88, 0, 6)
    box.BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Btn
    box.BorderSizePixel = 0
    box.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
    box.TextSize = 12
    box.TextColor3 = Theme.Accent
    box.Text = tostring(default)
    box.ClearTextOnFocus = false
    box.Parent = row
    Instance.new("UICorner", box).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6)

    local track_ = Instance.new("Frame")
    track_.Size = UDim2.new(1, -28, 0, 10)
    track_.Position = UDim2.new(0, 14, 1, -18)
    track_.BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Btn
    track_.BorderSizePixel = 0
    track_.Parent = row
    Instance.new("UICorner", track_).CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)

    local fill = Instance.new("Frame")
    fill.Size = UDim2.new(0, 0, 1, 0)
    fill.BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Accent
    fill.BorderSizePixel = 0
    fill.Parent = track_
    Instance.new("UICorner", fill).CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)

    local fillGrad = Instance.new("UIGradient")
    fillGrad.Color = ColorSequence.new(Theme.Accent, Theme.Accent2)
    fillGrad.Parent = fill

    local knob = Instance.new("Frame")
    knob.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(18, 18)
    knob.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
    knob.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0.5, 0)
    knob.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
    knob.BorderSizePixel = 0
    knob.ZIndex = 2
    knob.Parent = track_
    Instance.new("UICorner", knob).CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)

    local hit = Instance.new("TextButton")
    hit.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 24)
    hit.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0.5, -17)
    hit.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    hit.Text = ""
    hit.ZIndex = 3
    hit.Parent = track_

    local current = default

    local function set(v, updateBox)
        v = tonumber(v)
        if not v then v = current end
        v = math.clamp(v, min, max)
        current = v
        local t = (max == min) and 0 or (v - min) / (max - min)
        fill.Size = UDim2.new(t, 0, 1, 0)
        knob.Position = UDim2.new(t, 0, 0.5, 0)
        if updateBox ~= false then box.Text = string.format("%.2f", v) end
        local ok, err = pcall(callback, v)
        if not ok then warn("[Boombox] slider callback:", err) end
    end

    hit.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
        if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
        or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
            local function update(i)
                local rel = (i.Position.X - track_.AbsolutePosition.X) / math.max(1, track_.AbsoluteSize.X)
                rel = math.clamp(rel, 0, 1)
                set(min + rel * (max - min), true)
            end
            activeDrag = update
            update(input)
        end
    end)

    box.FocusLost:Connect(function(enter)
        if enter then set(box.Text, true) end
    end)

    set(default, true)
    return { set = set, get = function() return current end, frame = row }
end

local function makeToggle(parent, labelText, default, callback)
    local row = makeCard(parent, 44)

    local lbl = Instance.new("TextLabel")
    lbl.Size = UDim2.new(1, -90, 1, 0)

    lbl.TextSize = 12
    lbl.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
    lbl.TextColor3 = Theme.Text
    lbl.Text = labelText
    lbl.Parent = row

    local isOn = default

    local pill = Instance.new("Frame")
    pill.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(50, 26)
    pill.Position = UDim2.new(1, -64, 0.5, -13)
    pill.BackgroundColor3 = isOn and Theme.Success or Theme.Btn
    pill.BorderSizePixel = 0
    pill.Parent = row
    Instance.new("UICorner", pill).CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)

    local knob = Instance.new("Frame")
    knob.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(20, 20)
    knob.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 0.5)
    knob.Position = isOn and UDim2.new(1, -23, 0.5, 0) or UDim2.new(0, 3, 0.5, 0)
    knob.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
    knob.BorderSizePixel = 0
    knob.Parent = pill
    Instance.new("UICorner", knob).CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)

    local clickable = Instance.new("TextButton")
    clickable.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
    clickable.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    clickable.Text = ""
    clickable.Parent = row

    local function set(v)
        isOn = v
        tween(pill, {BackgroundColor3 = isOn and Theme.Success or Theme.Btn}, 0.2)
        if isOn then
            tween(knob, {Position = UDim2.new(1, -23, 0.5, 0)}, 0.2)
        else
            tween(knob, {Position = UDim2.new(0, 3, 0.5, 0)}, 0.2)
        end
        local ok, err = pcall(callback, v)
        if not ok then warn("[Boombox] toggle callback:", err) end
    end
    clickable.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() set(not isOn) end)

    return { set = set, get = function() return isOn end }
end

local function makeRowButtons(parent, specs)
    local row = Instance.new("Frame")
    row.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 34)
    row.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    row.Parent = parent
    local n = #specs
    local gap = 6
    for i, s in ipairs(specs) do
        local b = Instance.new("TextButton")
        b.Size = UDim2.new(1 / n, -(gap * (n - 1)) / n, 1, 0)
        b.Position = UDim2.new((i - 1) / n, ((i - 1) * gap) / n, 0, 0)
        b.BackgroundColor3 = s.color or Theme.Btn
        b.BorderSizePixel = 0
        b.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
        b.TextSize = 12
        b.TextColor3 = Theme.Text
        b.Text = s.text
        b.AutoButtonColor = false
        b.Parent = row
        Instance.new("UICorner", b).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 10)
        local base = s.color or Theme.Btn
        addHover(b, base, base:Lerp(Color3.new(1, 1, 1), 0.15))
        b.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
            local ok, err = pcall(s.callback)
            if not ok then warn("[Boombox] btn err:", err) end
        end)
    end
    return row
end

local function normalizeId(raw)
    raw = (raw or ""):gsub("%s+", "")
    if raw == "" then return nil end
    if tonumber(raw) then
        return "rbxassetid://" .. raw
    end
    if raw:match("^rbxassetid://") then return raw end
    if raw:match("^https?://") then
        local id = raw:match("(%d+)")
        if id then return "rbxassetid://" .. id end
    end
    return raw
end

local function ensureSound()
    if state.sound and state.sound.Parent then return state.sound end
    local s = Instance.new("Sound")
    s.Name = "BoomboxSound"
    s.Looped = state.looped
    s.Volume = state.volume
    s.PlaybackSpeed = state.speed
    s.Pitch = state.pitch
    s.Parent = SoundService
    state.sound = s
    return s
end

local function stopSound()
    if state.sound then
        state.sound:Stop()
        state.sound:Destroy()
        state.sound = nil
    end
    state.playing = false
end

local function playSound()
    if state.soundId == "" then
        setStatus("Enter a music id first.")
        return
    end
    stopSound()
    local s = ensureSound()
    s.SoundId = state.soundId
    s.Volume = state.volume
    s.PlaybackSpeed = state.speed
    s.Pitch = state.pitch
    s.Looped = state.looped
    local ok, err = pcall(function() s:Play() end)
    if not ok then
        setStatus("Playback failed.")
        return
    end
    state.playing = true
    setStatus("Playing.")
end

local function pauseSound()
    if state.sound and state.playing then
        state.sound:Pause()
        state.playing = false
        setStatus("Paused.")
    end
end

local function resumeSound()
    if state.sound and not state.playing then
        state.sound:Resume()
        state.playing = true
        setStatus("Resumed.")
    end
end

local tabs = {}

local function registerTab(name, icon, buildFn)
    local btn = Instance.new("TextButton")
    btn.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 38)
    btn.LayoutOrder = #tabs + 1
    btn.BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Btn
    btn.BackgroundTransparency = 0.55
    btn.BorderSizePixel = 0
    btn.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
    btn.TextSize = 12
    btn.TextColor3 = Theme.Text
    btn.Text = "   " .. icon .. "   " .. name
    btn.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
    btn.AutoButtonColor = false
    btn.Parent = sideScroll
    Instance.new("UICorner", btn).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8)

    local page = makePage(content)
    buildFn(page)

    local entry = { name = name, btn = btn, page = page }
    tabs[#tabs + 1] = entry

    btn.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
        if entry.page.Visible then return end
        tween(btn, {BackgroundColor3 = Theme.BtnHi})
    end)
    btn.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
        if entry.page.Visible then return end

local function makeDraggable(object)
	local dragging = false
	local dragStart
	local startPosition

	object.InputBegan:Connect(function(inputObject)
		if inputObject.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
			or inputObject.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then

			dragging = true
			dragStart = inputObject.Position
			startPosition = object.Position

			inputObject.Changed:Connect(function()
				if inputObject.UserInputState == Enum.UserInputState.End then
					dragging = false
				end
			end)
		end
	end)

	UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(inputObject)
		if not dragging then
			return
		end

		if inputObject.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement
			or inputObject.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then

			local delta = inputObject.Position - dragStart

			object.Position = UDim2.new(
				startPosition.X.Scale,
				startPosition.X.Offset + delta.X,
				startPosition.Y.Scale,
				startPosition.Y.Offset + delta.Y
			)
		end
	end)
end

		local digitValue = tonumber(string.sub(cleanCode, index, index))
		local digitPart = keypadFolder:FindFirstChild("Digit" .. index)

		if digitPart then
			local clickDetector = digitPart:FindFirstChildOfClass("ClickDetector")
			if clickDetector then
				for i = 1, digitValue do
					fireclickdetector(clickDetector)
					task.wait(0.15)
				end
			end
		end

		task.wait(0.4)
	end
end
